featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!

today.name: CONVOY DECEPTICONS  ROBO DE CAMIONES A LOS AUTOBOTS
today.description:
TEMATICA DE TRANSPORTE DE CAMIONES 


El cielo sobre las carreteras del Pacífico Noroeste amenazaba tormenta cuando el convoy clandestino cruzó la frontera estatal de Montana. Tres imponentes camiones con especificaciones de los Autobots avanzaban en perfecta formación, pero sus sistemas de navegación habituales habían sido completamente hackeados. En las pantallas de sus cabinas parpadeaba un frío emblema morado.
	Los Decepticons habían ejecutado una emboscada perfecta en los talleres mecánicos de Sandpoint, Montana, apoderándose de valiosa tecnología de transporte enemiga. Ahora, la misión consistía en llevar el botín hasta su base secreta de operaciones en Sidney, Montana, antes de que la resistencia local o las patrullas fronterizas detectaran la anomalía.
A la vanguardia del grupo, guiando la ruta a través de los desolados paisajes montañosos de la Interestatal 90 y las rutas secundarias hacia el este, un imponente camión escolta lideraba la marcha. A través de la frecuencia encriptada de Truckers MP, el comandante a cargo emitió una orden directa a las unidades de soporte:
—Mantengan la formación en US Simulation y desactiven los rastreadores GPS de las cargas. Nos dirigimos directo a los sectores del este. Si algún rezagado interfiere en el camino a Sidney, aplástenlo.
Los motores diésel rugieron al unísono, devorando kilómetros de asfalto en la penumbra. Con los mapas de navegación fijados firmemente en las coordenadas finales de Sidney, el convoy avanzaba implacable. Cada cambio de marcha acercaba a los Decepticons a consolidar su dominio logístico en el sector, dejando atrás a unos Autobots totalmente desprovistos de sus mejores transportes.

today.description:
## EXPORT OF CZECH LITERATURE TO THE BOOK FAIR!
- Export České literatury na Frakfurtský knižní veletrh!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/Y7M4QMA.jpeg)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is limited to the Office Papers.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)

upcoming.name: Oktober Konvoi Der Fire Phoenix
upcoming.description:
Wir starten um 20 Uhr unseren Oktober Monatskonvoi auf den Türkischen Straßen von Edirne aus in Richtung Jassy. (~1.330Km), guckt bitte das ihr rechtzeitig bereit steht und vorm Konvoi Start bitte die LKWs Repariert und Auftankt damit der Start reibungslos ablaufen kann und keine Probleme mit den LKWs unterwegs entstehen können.

Es wird bei diesem Konvoi eine 15 Minütige Pause eingeplant die in Pitesti auf den Speditionen Kaarfor u. Dom Depo Stattfinden wird. 

Folgender DLS ist erforderlich: https://store.steampowered.com/app/227310/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Going_East/?curator_clanid=4419325

Wir Starten von Edirne mit Singletrailer (Maximal 10T Fracht) in Fahrtrichtung Landschaft. 

Zum Abschluss bleiben wir an der Spedition Kaarfor um Paar Gruppenbilder nach der Gemeinsamen fahrt zu machen, dafür Parken/stellen wir die Auflieger ein/zur Seite damit die nicht stören oder im Weg stehen
upcoming.rule:
Es gilten die Standart Konvoi regeln:
- Überholen ist Strickt untersagt. Wenn Fremdfahrer auf der Karte oder im Tab auftauchen sollten, Passieren lassen
- Konvoispitze gibt die Geschwindigkeit an, versucht bitte mindestens 100 Meter zu eurem Vorderman einzuhalten um rechzeitig reagieren zu können (ausweichen/Bremsen)

upcoming.rule:
📜 **ETS2 / TRUCKERSMP CONVOY RULES** 📜

### Article 1 – General Rules

- All participants must follow the official TruckersMP rules as well as the instructions given by the convoy organizers.
- Respect, courtesy and fair play are mandatory towards all participants.
- Any intentional disruption of the convoy may result in immediate removal.

### Article 2 – Convoy Preparation

- Participants must be present at the departure point at least 15 minutes before the scheduled departure time.
- Each driver must park in the position assigned by the organizers.
- Departure may only take place following instructions from the Leader or Convoy Control.
- Staff-exclusive player tags must never be used by participants.

### Article 3 – Driving Behaviour

- Overtaking other participants is strictly prohibited unless authorized by the staff.
- Each driver must maintain a safe distance from the vehicle in front.
- Sudden and unnecessary braking is prohibited.
- Participants must maintain their assigned position within the convoy.
- The speed limits set by the Leader must be respected.
- Dangerous driving, intentional collisions or trolling will result in disciplinary action.

### Article 4 – Communication

- Voice communications must remain clear and related to the convoy.
- Insults, provocations and discriminatory remarks are prohibited.
- Only the Leader and moderation team may give traffic and convoy instructions.
- Off-topic discussions should be kept to a minimum during the journey.
